title: Check current LinkedIn company
description: Add URLs directly, paste CSV, or upload a CSV file.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: Header: url. Current Company Checker also accepts previousCompany.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many profile URLs to check at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse the same ID after a stopped large run to skip URLs that already completed.

freshStart.title: Check finished URLs again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and check the whole list again.
